verdict.rationale: Manufact creates a preview environment for each branch, each with its own MCP URL, so changes can be tested against real clients before merging. A configurable production branch serves the canonical production URL. Servers can also run locally with hot reload and an inspector, which keeps testing off the production deployment. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that preview environments isolate data, secrets or env vars from production, documentation of a dedicated sandbox mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
